title: Oral Ulcer Prevalence: Hospital-based Cross-sectional Study
brief_summary: Oral Ulcers have serious effect on patients' lives. Due to absence of any information about its prevalence, risk factors and effect on patients' lives, this study has been held. The investigators recruited patients from the outpatient dental clinic of the faculty of oral and dental medicine, Cairo University, screened them clinically for oral ulcers. All patients filled questionnaires about the risk factors of oral ulcers. Furthermore, oral ulcer patients filled questionnaires about their Quality of life, previous treatments used, previous physicians visited and their Quality of life after using previous treatments.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects whose age was above 15 years old.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects having problem in opening their mouth (due to non-oral ulcer cause) or undergoing intermaxillary fixation where oral examination was not possible.
study_population: patients attending the outpatient clinic of oral diagnosis, department of Oral Medicine, Oral Diagnosis and Periodontology, Faculty of Oral and Dental Medicine, Cairo University.
